verdict: Shopify grew revenue 34% to $3.6B and reported $1.5B of net income — but $1.25B of that profit was a paper gain on its investment stakes; excluding equity investments, net income was $439M.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago (33% in constant currency)

segments.name: Subscription solutions
segments.note: Monthly fees merchants pay to use the Shopify platform. Up 22% YoY.

segments.name: Merchant solutions
segments.note: Payments, shipping and other services that scale with merchant sales — mostly Shopify Payments. Up 37% YoY.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Selling the platform and winning new merchants. Up 20% YoY.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Building the platform and new commerce and AI features. Up 13% YoY.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: The back office — finance, legal and admin. Up 11% YoY.

opex.name: Transaction and loan losses
opex.note: Losses on merchant loans and cash advances, and transaction losses. Up 76% YoY.

follow100Note: Other income added $36.53 of every $100 — almost all of it a paper gain on investment stakes, not money from running stores' software. The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
otherDetail: Other income of $1,309M: a $1,249M unrealized (paper) gain on equity and other investments, plus $66M of interest income and a $1M realized gain, less a $7M foreign-exchange loss. The $22M loss on the equity-method investment (Flexport) is the separate equity line.
footerNote: The earnings release prints a condensed statement (operating income $488M, net other income including taxes of $1,014M, net income $1,502M); the split of that $1,014M into other income, the equity-method loss and tax comes from the detailed statement in Shopify's Form 10-Q filed the same day, as the release itself directs.

takeaways.title: Growth accelerated past 30% everywhere
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 34% to $3,583M, GMV (sales through the platform) rose 32% to $115.6B, and merchant solutions revenue rose 37% to $2,781M as more sales ran through Shopify Payments.

takeaways.title: Most of the profit is a paper gain
takeaways.text: Net income was $1,502M, but $1,249M of it was an unrealized gain on equity and other investments — stakes rising in value, not cash from the business. Shopify's own measure excluding equity investments puts net income at $439M.

takeaways.title: The core business still prints cash
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $654M — 18% of revenue — and operating income rose 68% to $488M. For Q3 Shopify guided revenue growth in the low thirties, percent-wise.

oneTimers: The $1,249M unrealized gain on equity and other investments included $731M from stakes with market prices and $522M of gross gains from an observable price change on a private investment, less an $11M loss on an investment option (10-Q detail). These paper gains are why GAAP net income of $1,502M is more than three times Shopify's $439M figure excluding equity investments.
